operator_CLI: <python> <new-frozen-driver>/tools/structured_world/run_native_execution_continuation.py --manifest <fresh qualified-host-bound full four-case V1 manifest> --output <fresh controller> --cases G1_mid,G3_mid [--execute]
single_case_CLI: Same full four-case manifest with --cases G1_mid (or G3_mid); no partial manifest accepted.
cases_default: All four original cases; frozen30bcbad default jobs/commands/capture controls exact against small metadata fixtures.
manifest_contract: Overall four-case manifest and bound original V1 criteria remain unchanged in PLAN with source-file hash; only dispatch selection added. Unselected origin/storage/output/RNG files are not read. Manifest order fixes selected job order.
actual_host_binding: Execute on the manifest qualified host, not remote forwarding. Parent must bind zt3 UUID/qualification/storage and staged selected mid origins in a fresh full four-case manifest; --cases does not override host or bypass readiness.

record_fields.unselected_receipts: No external receipts imported; early cases stay pending in this phase even if another controller later captures them.

budget.scope: Selected jobs only; whole selected plan before first launch and actual failed/success exits plus all remaining selected reserves before next.
budget.external_and_elsewhere: Still mandatory fresh explicit finite snapshots. Parent reserves or accounts for early/other dispatches; omitted cases are neither free nor completed.
budget.unknown_budget: Refused before any GPU launch; no default/guessed spending; existing120GPUh joint ceiling unchanged.

fresh_headroom_templates.admission: Unchanged strict actual OWN usage/physical/quota checks. Templates add1GiB metadata/log headroom per run; not proof of future headroom or exclusive filesystem availability. Fresh paths/binding required; no old artifact overwritten.
fresh_headroom_templates.negative_control: CPU actual metadata file makes45GiB cap fail unchanged storage_admission; fresh46GiB budget passes. Parent-reported zt3 failed GPU attempt/identity/cost preserved, not reclassified.

CPU_execute_test_scope: Synthetic producer mocks validate CLI/report scope only; no native GPU execution/acceptance receipt.
